language.tutorNotes: Taiwan Mandarin, written in Traditional characters. Pronunciation and vocabulary differ in places from mainland Mandarin (e.g. retroflex sounds are often softened); prefer Taiwan usage when it diverges. Tones still carry meaning — correct the tone, not just the syllable.

books.title: 三个成語故事
books.author: Traditional (ancient Chinese sources: Han Feizi, Zhan Guo Ce)

premise.en: Three classic fables behind famous Chinese idioms, retold in very simple modern Mandarin.
premise.fr: Trois fables classiques à l'origine de chengyu célèbres, racontées en mandarin moderne très simple.
premise.es: Tres fábulas clásicas que dieron origen a chengyu famosos, contadas en mandarín moderno muy sencillo.
